placement.rationale: Mid-cap placement balances the complete source-sized fractions beside letters and mixed-height figures. Top alignment lowers the denominators; bottom alignment raises the numerators beyond the existing Windows ascent. Center placement fits the existing metrics and retains all source differences.
placement.historical_limit: The charts do not establish a co-set historical text baseline. Row center 350 and 35-unit sidebearings are explicit modern layout choices. Full source physical dimensions and between-form differences remain.
placement.source_gap: Seek matching 10pt fractions or symbols co-set with letters or ordinary figures to establish historical baseline placement.

row_review.note: All three selected native rows were reviewed with top, center and bottom overlays. Fits use only fractions, at threshold 150 except LOC 190; shorter cent and percent retain native positions under the same transform.

regular-fraction-10-atf-handy-1897-0.method: Estimate row skew from whole-form ink-box centers at threshold 150, or 190 for the faint LOC impression. Every row fit excludes the shorter cent/percent. All available traced fractions determine the row fit; their exact IDs and count are recorded. Use one row translation, preserving differences between forms. This is not a measured text baseline.

atf-handy-1897.method: Independent common-capital and repeated-footer physical scale.

atf-new-york-1897.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

atf-handy-byu-1897.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

atf-american-line-1906.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

atf-desk-1898.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

common_capital_fit.method: One isotropic least-squares fit to common capitals after measured row rotation; independent repeated footer transfers scale to fraction chart. Wider10/12pt S forms remain comparison-only and do not set scale.

footer_scale_transfer.method: Map 26 footer projection groups using threshold 170, combining the overlapping R/S pair in FOUNDERS. Measure ink bounds independently at five thresholds. Fit one isotropic 2D similarity transform to matched group centers. No fraction dimensions enter the fit.

quality_decisions: All 290 threshold trials across 49 whole impressions were reviewed on 21 PDF pages, alongside 60 native cells from six books.
BYU threshold 150 supplies clear whole quarters, half, three-quarters and one-third at the largest available native resolution.
New York threshold 150 two-thirds retains four complete parts. Lower thresholds break the numerator; higher thresholds introduce joins.

LOC threshold 180 three-eighths and five-eighths retain four complete parts and both counters. Threshold 170 opens a counter; 190 merges a slash end. The finer 172–184 range preserves the separated construction. American Line threshold 140 independently confirms three-eighths.

BYU threshold 70 one-eighth preserves the separate slash and both counters in the dark impression. Threshold 50 introduces tiny defects; 90 and higher join the slash to the eight. No repairs are drawn.
New York threshold 150 cent and percent retain complete strokes and the three intended percent counters.
Seven-eighths remains a source-quality gap: the reviewed whole impressions either lose fine strokes or merge the upper slash into the eight.
One isotropic source scale preserves whole-form dimensions. No individual height normalization, assembled parts, hole filling or drawn repairs.
identity_limit: Matched construction and proportional dimensions support grouping; identical historical punches or matrices are not established.

source_quality_gaps.⅞: Ten-point NY lower thresholds break numerator7 or8, while usable thresholds merge upper slash/8; American has the same tradeoff. BYU and LOC rows omit this form; Handy and NYPL are heavily joined. Seek an intact same-size whole impression before encoding.
